items.title: PG&E (PCG) Just Gave Investors Something To Think About
items.summary: PG&E (PCG) recently reported to the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission a contractor injury at its Haas Kings River Hydroelectric Project, an operational safety disclosure that may interest investors tracking utility risk, reliability, and compliance. items.title: PG&E (PCG) Stock Could Be 43% Overvalued As Undergrounding Progress Advances
items.summary: PG&E has had a mixed run in recent years, and the question many investors are circling now is whether the current share price lines up with the dividend stream that underpins most traditional utility valuations. With the stock still trading around the mid-teens, the issue is less about headlines and more about what that payout profile can really support.
